verdict.rationale: Ledgy explicitly markets financial reporting for equity under IFRS 2, UK GAAP, or US GAAP with tranche-level detail, one-click generation, and configurable settings/permissions, which is the closest documented capability to ASC 718 expense reporting — but ASC 718 is not explicitly named anywhere in the evidence, so it's unclear if US GAAP reporting maps directly to ASC 718 requirements auditors expect. Missing for 10: explicit mention of ASC 718 by name, audit-ready report format/sample, and any third-party/auditor validation that the output is accepted by auditors.
